what_it_solves: Shopifyブランド向けのコレクション並べ替え、マーケット別 merchandising、商品発見のA/Bテスト。公式サイトで確認。
subject: A Japan hypothesis for Kimonix
body:
We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company developing Japan channels for commerce technology. We see a Kimonix opportunity in Shopify collection merchandising for Japanese fashion retailers.

METI reported on August 26, 2025 that Japan’s 2024 B2C e-commerce market reached ¥26.1 trillion, with apparel at ¥2.8 trillion. For fashion retailers, localized sorting and measurable product discovery matter as seasonal assortments change.

We can run a paid validation with Japanese fashion retailers, using buyer evidence to select one workflow. For roughly the budget of one major US or German trade show, we can run six months of structured Japan validation. Would it be useful if I sent over the first Japanese fashion retail segment and collection-merchandising workflow I would test?
